mentions.name: Argyu
mentions.description: A debate and writing game platform that aims to incentivize better thinking. Each game features an AI judge that scores participants' answers against a public rubric covering criteria such as style, cohesion, and logic. Games currently use fake money and an ELO score, with the potential to run as a competitive game for real stakes.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a debate/writing game platform: https:argyu.fun

The mission is to incentivize better thinking. For each game there's an AI judge that scores everyone's answer based on a public rubric (style, cohesion, logic, etc).

Currently uses fake money and ELO score but thought it could be a very interesting competitive game for real stakes.
